title: Turning tracking on marks the first bin as default when none is
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in, and bin {Bin-B} is a second bin at {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BIN-B).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRKON-NODEF-01) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A} (the first bin row) and 5 in {Bin-B}.
  • {Part-A} was saved untracked with neither bin marked Default.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Read the Inventory section.
  3. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is on.
  4. Read the Inventory section again.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Read the {Part-A} row in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Inventory section lists {Bin-A} with 2 as the first row and {Bin-B} with 5 as the second; neither row carries the Default pill.
  • Step 4: The first bin row, {Bin-A}, now carries the Default pill and {Bin-B} does not. The quantities are unchanged: {Bin-A} 2 and {Bin-B} 5.
  • Step 5: The dialog closes with no bin error.
  • Step 6: Total Qty shows "7 Available" (2 + 5 = 7) and Bin Location / Quantity shows "{Bin-A} | 2" and "{Bin-B} | 5".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-E2, S5-R8, read 14 Oct 2026; Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 5: "Save an untracked part with bins and none marked default, then turn tracking on."); design canvas board 5.6 (Switch back on), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Story SV-10818 (updated 9 Oct 2026) does not yet carry S5-E2; the PRD wins. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E2: “A part reaches S5-R8 with bin locations and no default in two ways: the bin location that was its default is deleted in Administration → Bin Locations while the part holds 0 there, or an untracked part is saved with bin locations and none marked default.”
  • S5-R8: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the dialog marks the first one as the default.”
